mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store (merchant_id, name, address, longitude, latitude, phone, business_hours, cover_image_file_id, business_status, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{phone}, #{businessHours}, #{coverImageFileId}, #{businessStatus}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE store SET name=#{name}, address=#{address}, longitude=#{longitude}, latitude=#{latitude}, phone=#{phone}, business_hours=#{businessHours}, cover_image_file_id=#{coverImageFileId}, business_status=#{businessStatus}, status=#{status}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, merchant_id, name, address, longitude, latitude, phone, business_hours, cover_image_file_id, business_status, status, created_at, updated_at FROM store WHERE id=#{id}
